summary: PRD v0.2 preserves the personal learning purpose while defining the requested full real-project workbench. F-01 through F-18 cover workspace/worktree import, creation and deletion; concurrent sessions and clean-context subagents; tool, permission and mode controls; right-side browser and other previews; commands; Git, terminal, harness management, recovery and local automation. The document gives observable success and failure criteria, concrete deletion and permission safeguards, a primary personal-use outcome and learning threshold, privacy boundaries, evidence limits, and full-scope release sequencing. assistant-ui and tool-ui have distinct integration roles. SDK and platform uncertainties are explicit pre-implementation holds, not silent feature cuts. No material product ambiguity or contradiction prevents user review and subsequent design specification.
review_boundary: Independent read-only semantic review of the registered PRD v0.2 against revision 2 plan and cited research. This pass evaluates product-document quality and readiness for user approval, not implementation.
verification_limits: Reviewed local PRD, plan, contract and research with exact file hashes; did not modify artifacts or run app tests.

Research records official-document findings but package versions and runtime compatibility are unpinned and untested. No SDK, UI, permission enforcement, filesystem safety, reconnection or personal learning behavior was exercised.
The local-browser delivery remains a proposal; platform choice must be resolved before platform-dependent design. This verdict is not user approval of the PRD or any external action.
next_handoff: Coordinator registers this product report, checks product handoff, and presents exact PRD v0.2 for user approval before dependent domain specifications.
